profile.bio:
Based out of Houston, Ashish leads a global group of energy, commodities and technology sector experts analyzing net-zero emissions pathways. He works extensively with CXOs & policy makers to decipher the inter-dependencies between various components of the energy transition, to facilitate strategic decision-making.

His team analyses asset valuations and investments, financing and contractual structures, technology evolution, policy developments and demand-supply drivers in power, natural gas & LNG, oil & petrochemicals, metals & mining, biofuels, and carbon markets.

In his previous role as the Head of Asia Pacific Research at BloombergNEF in Singapore, he also analyzed and advised on renewable energy, battery storage, sustainable finance, and mobility sectors.

Over the years Ashish has spoken at leading forums such as the World Future Energy Summit, World Energy Leader’s Summit and the Clean Energy Ministerial, hosted dialogues with G-20 ministers and given inputs to the works of the World Economic Forum and the World Energy Council. He has also shared his views at the London Stock Exchange, the White House executive office and at leading educational institutions.

Prior to joining Bloomberg, he led digital technology, capital budgeting and business process re-engineering projects across the world at European and Indian business consulting and technology firms. Ashish started his career at one of India’s largest private sector power companies where he oversaw commercial operations and smart grid deployment. An alumnus of the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kanpur, he has a first-class degree in Engineering and an MBA in Finance and Strategy. Ashish is also a graduate of the Harvard Business School’s Advanced Management Program.
profile.job_title: Managing Director, Commodities Research & Product Strategy

profile.bio: Sisi Tang is China Research Manager at BloombergNEF (BNEF), a strategic research provider covering low-carbon technologies and business model transitions. She leads BNEF’s coverage of China’s energy transition strategies and pathways, with a focus on energy system, low-carbon technologies and sectoral decarbonization. Sisi has over ten years of experience in energy research and commodity market analysis.

Salih Yilmaz is one of the senior analysts at Bloomberg Intelligence, and has worked in energy finance and research for over 10 years. He covers a wide range of companies in EMEA including Saudi Aramco, Sabic and Repsol. He leads BI’s research on OPEC and oil as a commodity, and regularly publishes reports that focus on OPEC strategy and oil market balance.
 
Before joining Bloomberg Intelligence, he worked in investment banking focusing on the energy sector. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Economics and Mathematics from Vanderbilt University, and an MPhil in Finance from The University of Cambridge. He is a Chartered Financial Analyst.

Vijay is the Group Head of ESG and Chief Sustainability Officer for Emirates NBD Group, where he leads the sustainability strategy and its implementation across the organization. He is responsible for the Sustainable and Transition Finance Strategy & Implementation, as well as overseeing the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) programs for the Group. With 20 years of experience in sustainability within the banking sector, Vijay has previously worked with the European Bank of Reconstruction & Development, Lloyds Banking Group, and in consulting roles for KPMG UK in Sustainable Finance & ESG Strategy. His expertise includes designing sustainable finance frameworks, conducting due diligence, and managing sustainability risk. 

Vijay is the Chairperson of UAE Banks Federation (UBF) committee. Vijay is the committee member for the Taskforce on Inequality and Social related Financial Disclosures (TISFD). Vijay is an active member of several prominent councils, including the UAE Banking Federation Sustainability Leadership Council, DIFC Sustainable Finance Council, ADGM Sustainable Finance Leadership Council, World Economic Forum (WEF) of Sustainability Leaders, and S&P Sustainability Leadership Council. Additionally, he is a Chartered Environmental Scientist and a Member of the Royal Geographical Society.
profile.job_title: Vijay Bains, Chief Sustainability Officer and Group Head ESG

profile.bio:
Jonathan Luan is the Head of Finance and Investment Research for BloombergNEF, based in London. He leads BloombergNEF’s global coverage on the climate transition of banks, asset managers and asset owners, and the opportunities and gaps in energy transition finance and investment.

He has a decade of experience in coal and renewable energy policy, power market and economics, and corporate sustainability. BloombergNEF is a strategic research provider covering global commodity markets and the disruptive technologies driving the transition to a low-carbon economy. Jonathan holds a master's degree from the George Washington University in Washington, D.C.
profile.job_title: Head of Finance and Investment Research

profile.bio:
Yasmine Rifai is an AI and Digital Transformation leader with more than 15 years of experience at the intersection of technology, government, and innovation. She holds a degree in Computer Engineering and began her career in Lebanon as a Software Engineer, where she spent four years building a strong foundation in technology and systems design.

Nearly a decade ago, Yasmine relocated to Kuwait, joining Deloitte, where she spent six years leading large-scale digital transformation projects.

For the past four years, she has served as the Technology Lead for Microsoft’s Public Sector in Kuwait (CTO). In this role, she has led and architected the strategic partnership with the Kuwait government, along with national initiatives in AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital infrastructure. She has shaped government adoption models, driven national strategies, and established frameworks that accelerate transformation at scale. Her work includes building best practices that ensure technology adoption translates into sustainable impact for citizens and institutions.

Yasmine is also a published author, with her debut book Mindset Decoded exploring intentional growth and leadership. She has authored multiple white papers and contributed thought leadership to leading platforms and publications. As a global speaker and advocate for diversity and inclusion, she brings the perspectives of the Middle East into global conversations on AI, digital transformation in government, leadership, and the future of work.

Dr Ibraheem Almansouri is Senior Director of Engineering at Masdar, a global clean energy leader. In this role, he oversees technical support for Business Development and Investment, Bidding, Project Delivery, Portfolio Management, and Special Projects & Distributed Generation. He was previously a senior member of the Business Development bidding team, with responsibility for various projects in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region.

Dr Almansouri has extensive experience in academia and research, including a wide range of strategic and commercial exposure and practical experience.

Dr Almansouri is the recipient of several regional and global awards, including the Emirates Energy Award (2014–2015 cycle) and the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) Myron Zucker Industry Applications Award (2008). He is an active member of the Mohammed Bin Rashid Academy of Scientists.

Dr Almansouri holds:

* An Executive MBA from INSEAD
* A PhD in Photovoltaic and Renewable Energy Engineering from the University of New South Wales, Australia
* A Master of Laws (LLM) in International Business Law from Paris-Panthéon-Assas University
* An MSc in Renewable Energy Management from the University of Freiburg, Germany
* A Bachelor of Electrical Engineering from the American University of Sharjah

He completed his master’s thesis at the Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems (ISE) and his PhD under the Masdar Research Network initiative.

Eduardo Ortiz Gross is Head of Corporate & Investment Banking for the Middle East and North Africa at BBVA, based in Abu Dhabi. He is responsible for developing the bank’s business across the region and connecting corporate, institutional and sovereign-related clients with BBVA’s global financing, advisory and markets capabilities.

Prior to his current role, Eduardo was Head of Strategy for BBVA’s Corporate & Investment Banking division, where he worked on the business’s strategic transformation and international growth agenda. He previously held strategy and development roles at BBVA and began his career at Boston Consulting Group.

Eduardo holds an MBA from Harvard Business School and a degree in Economics from CIDE in Mexico.
profile.job_title: Head of Corporate & Investment Banking for the Middle East and North Africa

profile.bio:
Steven is Managing Director at Stonepeak and driving the firm’s investment activities across the Middle East. In this role he focuses on opportunities in energy transition, transport and logistics, digital communications, and social infrastructure.

Prior to joining Stonepeak, Steven pursued Australia's most ambitious trade and investment agenda while serving as Australia's Minister for Trade, Tourism & Investment. He negotiated and secured economy boosting agreements by completing the Comprehensive and Progressive Trans Pacific Partnership (TPP11) as well as the Indonesia-Australia Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IA-CEPA) and numerous other trade and investment deals.

Steven served in a number of senior Ministerial roles as a Member of Australia’s Parliament for nearly 18 years, including in Defence Industry, International Development and the Pacific, and as the Parliamentary Secretary to the Treasurer.

Badr Bentassil is the Business Development Director at O-GREEN Energy, Oman's sovereign-backed green energy and
data-centre platform, which combines utility-scale renewable power and storage with the development of AI-ready data-
centre campuses.

He leads the platform's international energy business development. His work centres on securing grid access, developing round-the-clock renewables and storage, and structuring bankable contracts for O-GREEN's own data-centre campuses.

He brings over 12 years of experience in utility-scale renewable energy development and finance across the Middle East, Africa and Europe, gained in senior roles at TotalEnergies, EDF Renewables and a Masdar affiliate.

Ahmed Gamal El Din is Vice President, Cloud & Service Provider Segment, International Operations at Schneider Electric. In this role, he leads the company’s strategy and business growth for the segment, working with the world’s leading hyperscale cloud, colocation, and service provider customers across international markets.

With nearly two decades of experience spanning energy management, digital infrastructure, and data center technologies, Ahmed has held leadership roles across multiple markets and built extensive experience in driving business transformation, accelerating growth, and developing high-performing teams. 

Throughout his career, he has helped strengthen Schneider Electric’s role as a trusted partner for the digital economy,  upporting customers as they scale more sustainable, resilient, and AI-ready infrastructure.

Prior to his current role, Ahmed served as Vice President of Secure Power & Data Centers for Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Pakistan, where he led strategic initiatives that accelerated market expansion, strengthened customer partnerships, and delivered continued business growth across the region.

Ahmed is widely recognized for his expertise in data centers, cloud infrastructure, sustainability, power distribution, and digital transformation. He is passionate about enabling the convergence of energy and technology and helping organizations navigate the transition toward a more electric, digital, and sustainable future.

He holds a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and an MBA in Marketing and has completed advanced leadership development programs across multiple regions. A frequent speaker at industry events and executive forums, Ahmed actively contributes to discussions shaping the future of digital infrastructure, artificial intelligence, energy efficiency, and sustainability worldwide.
profile.job_title: Vice President, Cloud & Service Provider Segment, International Operations
